result.instructions: Tools for Delfi PMS, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our properties have a lease ending in the next 60 days?"; "List the payments received this month for one of our properties."; "Show the open maintenance requests with their priority and unit.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Delfi PMS data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run delfipms_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run delfipms_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run delfipms_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. delfipms_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: delfipms_list_properties
tools.title: List properties
tools.description: List the properties in the workspace, paginated. Start here: property ids feed the unit and expense tools. Delfi API: GET /api/properties.

tools.name: delfipms_list_units
tools.title: List units of a property
tools.description: List the units of one property, with their address, status and size. Delfi API: GET /api/properties/{property}/units.

property_id.description: The property id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_leases
tools.title: List leases
tools.description: List leases, optionally filtered by property or unit. Returns the rent amount, dates, payment frequency and reminder settings. Delfi API: GET /api/leases.

tools.name: delfipms_get_lease
tools.title: Get a lease
tools.description: Get one lease by id, with its property and unit. Delfi API: GET /api/leases/{lease}.

lease_id.description: The lease id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_payments
tools.title: List payments
tools.description: List payments, optionally filtered by property, unit or tenant. Returns amounts, dates, status and the paying tenant. Contains financial personal data. Delfi API: GET /api/payments.

tools.name: delfipms_get_payment
tools.title: Get a payment
tools.description: Get one payment by id. Delfi API: GET /api/payments/{payment}.

payment_id.description: The payment id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices, optionally filtered by property or unit. Returns amounts, currency, description and line items. Delfi API: GET /api/invoices.

tools.name: delfipms_list_owners
tools.title: List owners
tools.description: List property owners, with the properties and units they own. Contains personal contact details. Delfi API: GET /api/owners.

tools.name: delfipms_get_owner
tools.title: Get an owner
tools.description: Get one owner by id. Contains personal contact details. Delfi API: GET /api/owners/{owner}.

owner_id.description: The owner id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_tenants
tools.title: List tenants
tools.description: List tenants, with the properties and units they rent. Contains personal contact details. Delfi API: GET /api/tenants.

tools.name: delfipms_get_tenant
tools.title: Get a tenant
tools.description: Get one tenant by id. Contains personal contact details. Delfi API: GET /api/tenants/{tenant}.

tenant_id.description: The tenant id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_property_expenses
tools.title: List expenses of a property
tools.description: List the expenses of one property (required: property_id), with amounts, tax, due and payment dates and the supplier. Delfi API: GET /api/properties/{property}/expenses.

property_id.description: The property id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_unit_expenses
tools.title: List expenses of a unit
tools.description: List the expenses of one unit (required: unit_id), with amounts, tax, due and payment dates and the supplier. Delfi API: GET /api/units/{unit}/expenses.

unit_id.description: The unit id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_maintenance
tools.title: List maintenance requests
tools.description: List maintenance requests with their status, priority, property and unit. Delfi API: GET /api/maintenance.

tools.name: delfipms_get_maintenance
tools.title: Get a maintenance request
tools.description: Get one maintenance request by id, with its description and images. Delfi API: GET /api/maintenance/{maintenance}.

maintenance_id.description: The maintenance request id (from a list tool).

tools.name: delfipms_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers (trades and contractors) with their profession and contact details. Delfi API: GET /api/suppliers.

tools.name: delfipms_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id. Delfi API: GET /api/suppliers/{supplier}.

supplier_id.description: The supplier id (from a list tool).
